renderingContract.grammarStorage: External versioned packs installed before launch; loading and initialization occur inside app execution; no network or precomputed highlighting.
renderingContract.objective: Comparable visible features with idiomatic platform rendering engines.
renderingContract.sharedLibraries: React Native and web hosts must use identical Legend List DOM artifacts from the same snapshot.
renderingContract.preparation: Lazy documents and viewport-driven Markdown; retain normal framework prefetch and row caches. Do not pre-render the full history or preload persistent highlighting results.
renderingContract.nativePrefetch: Flutter's indexed list retains its two-viewport minimum; AppKit and SwiftUI retain framework-controlled preparation. Equal offscreen row counts are not claimed.
renderingContract.highlighting: Explicit fence languages, common language and fallback policy, foreground-only colors; idiomatic engines may produce different token boundaries.
renderingContract.codeText: Remove terminal newline characters only; preserve spaces, tabs and internal blank lines.
renderingContract.scope: Pinned text-only transcripts; images disabled. Full Markdown extension conformance and pixel identity are not claimed.

metrics.buildSizeBytes: Logical bytes of every file in the production .app bundle.
metrics.discoveryMs: App-side wall time from starting native Codex and Claude history traversal until the discovered catalog is available to the app. This interval is contained within firstContentMs.
metrics.firstContentMs: Process launch to the first of three recorded frames matching the settled initial transcript region (excluding sidebar/header).
metrics.internalReadiness: App-declared window and content readiness retained for stage diagnosis; not used as visual timing authority when video is enabled.
metrics.memory: Median of 3 settled aggregate samples beginning 2500 ms after each content or viewport readiness boundary, spaced 200 ms apart, for the app process tree and attributable WebKit XPC helpers. macOS physical footprint is the primary memory-cost metric; RSS is retained as a secondary resident-mapping diagnostic.
metrics.stages: Native file/parser time and remaining bridge plus viewport-layout time within each content-open cycle.
metrics.switchContentMs: Selection start to the first of three recorded frames matching the settled switched transcript region (excluding sidebar/header).
metrics.topJumpMs: Non-animated jump request to the first of three recorded frames matching the settled top transcript region (excluding sidebar/header).
metrics.windowOpenMs: Process launch to the first of three recorded frames in which the app window replaces the pre-launch pixels.

protocol.windowPresentation: Process-local NSAutomaticWindowAnimationsEnabled=NO before app initialization; shells shown without waiting for transcript content.
protocol.desktopSession: Requires an unlocked console session before every launch and after each observation; session failures abort without retry.
protocol.cache: Fixture verification reads and hashes every byte before measurements, producing a controlled warm filesystem cache.
protocol.discovery: Every app receives only the two stable provider/id pairs, scans the native Codex and Claude history stores itself, and resolves both transcript paths inside the measured startup path.
protocol.memoryCaptureIsolation: Settled memory is sampled in a companion production launch without ScreenCaptureKit, which can charge capture surfaces to GPU-backed apps. Video-derived timing comes from the immediately preceding launch, which performs no footprint sampling.
protocol.order: Deterministic round-robin rotation across apps for every warm-up and measured round.
protocol.retries: At most 3 attempts per launch; only complete observations enter aggregates.
protocol.visualAuthority: Timestamped target-60-fps ScreenCaptureKit application-surface capture with a cropped audit video and frame-evidence sidecar for every measured iteration.
